case.title: Last product never shows up in the catalog
case.summary: Bug: commit 882203d introduced `const lastIndex = items.length - 1` and replaced `Math.ceil(items.length / pageSize)` with `Math.ceil(lastIndex / pageSize)` in src/catalog/paginate.ts. For 25 products at 6 per page, this computed totalPages=4 instead of 5, making the Next button disable one page too early and leaving the Wool Pashmina Shawl unreachable. Fix: removed the erroneous `lastIndex` variable and restored `Math.ceil(items.length / pageSize)`. Repro test (3 assertions) went RED→GREEN. Full suite: 107/107 passed. Critic: APPROVED.

events.title: Case opened — bug-04: last product missing from catalog pagination

data.summary: 25 products, pager stops at page 4 of 4, last product unreachable when last page has exactly 1 item

data.root: paginate.ts line 17: Math.ceil(lastIndex/pageSize) uses items.length-1 instead of items.length, causing totalPages=4 for 25 items at 6/page instead of 5
